userStory.desire: As a Wesley Runtime Client Engineer, I want generated TypeScript runtime clients and pump helpers to be integration-ready with no post-processing.

motivation.summary: Ready-to-use host clients shrink app-level glue and reduce long-lived workaround debt.
supportsOrUnblocks: Directly unblocks JWE-006, JWE-007, and X-001.
Creates a stable generated seam for intent/query transport and view-op decoding.

acceptanceCriteria: Generated TypeScript runtime client includes typed dispatch/query APIs plus canonical pump loop.
Pump logic decodes view ops and routes envelopes without requiring handwritten patch scripts.
Generated client exposes registry handshake constants used by integration gates.

assertions: Generated client compiles in strict TypeScript mode with no manual edits.
Pump integration test validates decode + route of mixed view-op fixtures.
Handshake constant test verifies generated values align with protocol artifacts.
goldenPath: Generate client, import into sample app, dispatch intent, run pump, and render decoded view ops.
Execute typed query method and verify result decoding round-trip.
edgeCases: Empty view-op buffers return cleanly without emitting stale callbacks.
Unknown op id in pump stream is surfaced to diagnostics channel with raw payload context.
fuzzScale: Pump high-volume mixed op streams and verify stable throughput without dropped envelopes.
failureCases: Malformed binary payload fails decode with deterministic error object.
Missing runtime port methods fail generated client initialization with explicit contract message.
